## What's Changed

- Split Explore into Logs, Metrics, and Traces modes. Metrics adds bounded PromQL/MetricsQL charts and series tables for Prometheus and VictoriaMetrics; Tempo trace search is not included yet.
- Support larger Elasticsearch PIT IDs for broad index patterns with bounded pagination cursors.
- Optionally send release notes to #releases when the Slack webhook secret is configured.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/InvestiGenie/investigenie/compare/0.5.2...0.5.4
